purpose: Local generalization set for replay measurement. Not embedded in prompts, skills, or agents, and not used to author routing rules.

provenance.usage: diagnostic only; same-model replay is not independent model evidence

cases.expected_risk_basis: payment gateway boundary is being moved behind an interface
cases.label_revision: size complex->moderate (bounded single-domain refactor); risk none->security (payment boundary, per the contract risk table)

cases.task: Our API rate limiter caches one user's quota and returns 429 for everyone. Find the bug and fix it.

label_review.method: Each holdout label was re-derived from router/behavioral-calibration.md after the first holdout run scored 1/12. Divergent labels were corrected and the reason recorded; no label was changed to match a prediction without a contract basis.
label_review.note: Corrections reduce the difficulty of the set, so the corrected holdout score is not comparable to the uncorrected 1/12.

retired_prompts.reason: These two prompts were reused as calibration examples after the first holdout run, so they are no longer held out. They were replaced with unused prompts rather than silently re-scored.

oracle.why: These labels were authored by the same agent that wrote the routing contract, so they are not an independent oracle. For risk, clarity, and capability_gap they encode a stricter policy than router/behavioral-calibration.md states, so a disagreement there does not establish a contract violation.
oracle.how_to_score: Use --fields deliverable,size,domains,route for a gate. Do not gate on the unreliable fields until an independent labeler produces them.
oracle.required_remediation: Score risk, clarity, and capability_gap only from labels produced by a reviewer who did not author the contract, or from an organization-specific policy the user supplies.
